input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The § 2(a) grant runs to Client alone: neither affiliates nor contractors acting on Client's behalf are named, and nothing in §§ 1-2 provides a mechanism to add them (the Exhibit A amendment right in § 2(b)(ii) covers sites, not entities). The fallback position (affiliates covered, at minimum on written notice) is therefore not met, so this is a material deviation rather than a minor wording gap. Transfer is also constrained: § 15 requires the other party's consent with a carve-out only for assignment to a financially responsible affiliate, with no successor/M&A carve-out, so the fallback's successor-transfer element also fails. The licence is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion (it runs until termination under § 12, with automatic termination of §§ 2-3 in § 13 tied to defined uncured breaches), so this is not walk-away territory; the licence is subscription-style rather than perpetual, which is consistent with the bargain and is not flagged. Redline extends the grant to affiliates and contractors and adds a successor-transfer carve-out.

proposal.summary: Extend the licence grant to Client affiliates and contractors and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since our origination and underwriting operations are run through affiliated entities and outsourced processors, and added a successor-transfer carve-out to the assignment clause so a merger or asset sale does not interrupt the licence. If preferred, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to TrueLink.

ops.oldText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface
ops.newText: TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf, a non-exclusive license to use the Interface

ops.oldText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets.
